answer: In this PoA design, identity verification is bound to a Wesolowski VDF: each challenge requires a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with every result needed for the next. GPUs may increase throughput across independent identities, but cannot shorten one chain; simulating many clones therefore multiplies wall-clock work and exposes a strict physical time bottleneck, whether labels are nebula, umber, or orchard.
